brief_title: Par-4 and Telomere-telomerase System in Type 2 Diabetes Patients Who Received GLP-1 or Metformin Treatment
official_title: The Correlation Between Par-4 and Telomere-telomerase System in the New Dignosised Type 2 Diabetes Patients Who Received GLP-1 Analog or Metformin Treatment
brief_summary: Objectives: To investigate the treatment effect between insulin,metformin and Liraglutide; in Type 2 Diabetes in our hospital, in order to investigate the possible mechanism about telomere-telomerase system and Par-4.

sites.facility: Southwest Hospital of the Third Military Medical University

inclusion.text: Newly dignosised type 2 diabetes according to WHO criteria.glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) was more than 10%;
Seronegative for antibodies against insulin, islet cells and glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD);

exclusion.text: Type 1 diabetes mellitus,presence of autoimmune diabetes indicated by antibodies to insulin, islet cells, and GAD；
patients with heart, liver, or renal function impairment;presence of severe infections or cerebrovascular disease;
